description: SPP (Southwest Power Pool — 14 US states from the Texas panhandle to North Dakota) real-time generation by fuel type at 5-minute resolution: coal, natural gas, nuclear, wind, solar, hydro, diesel fuel oil, energy storage, waste heat, waste disposal, other, plus total load. Returns MW per fuel per interval. AUTHORITATIVE for SPP grid mix — PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "how much wind is SPP running right now", "SPP fuel mix today", "SPP wind share of load".

detailed.description: true = split each fuel into its Market and Self-scheduled halves over a rolling 365-day feed. Default false (the plain current-day feed).

limit.description: Latest N 5-minute intervals to return (default 12 = the most recent hour, max 2000).

name: spp_generation_mix
title: Spp Generation Mix
